args.query: Greeks Monte-Carlo CPU saturation quote timeout feature flag rollout

events.statement: pricing-engine latency_p99_ms jumps from ~60ms to ~2609ms in the bucket starting 2026-05-20T12:05:00Z and stays ~2600ms through 13:57Z.
pricing-engine cpu_pct jumps from ~40% to ~99-100% at the same 12:05Z bucket and remains saturated.
Config change cfg-3120 on pricing-engine set flags.pricing.greeks_v2.rollout_pct from 5 to 100 at 2026-05-20T12:04:00Z, described as 'Ramp Greeks v2 experiment to all traffic'.

pricing-engine logs show GreeksV2Calculator Monte-Carlo runs (paths=20000) taking 2964-8942ms, and 'request deadline exceeded computing quote (2000ms budget) calculator=GreeksV2' errors; first such WARN appears 2026-05-20T12:05:21Z.
pricing-engine error_rate rises from ~0.2% to 6.57% in the 12:02Z bucket and ~12.5% thereafter.
pricing-engine request_rate stays flat (~628-662 req/s) across the entire window; no traffic surge.
order-service logs 106 ERROR 'pricing-engine quote call timed out after 2500ms' entries starting 2026-05-20T12:06:10Z.
market-data-service latency_p99_ms stays flat at ~39-41ms across the whole window, unaffected at onset.
market-data-service cpu_pct stays flat at ~45% and error_rate flat at ~0.2% throughout the window.
The only market-data-service log in the window is a single 'deprecated TLS cipher offered by client' WARN at 11:43:53Z; no errors.
Deployment dep-6111 (market-data-service v5.2.0, 'Switch quote serialization to protobuf') was deployed at 2026-05-20T11:56:00Z and was not rolled back.
pricing-engine had no code deployments in the incident window.
pricing-engine memory_pct stays flat at ~48-49% throughout, ruling out a memory-driven failure.
